# ANT-TWIN preprint — tables (generated by `make_tables.py`; do not edit by hand)

Outcome labels follow the preregistered decision rules (prereg sec. 7): support H2 = 95% CI > 0; support H1 = 95% CI < 0; equivalence = 90% CI inside (−0.02; 0.02); otherwise undecided. 90% intervals for single fits are t-intervals with n − 6 df. For tree sets and resamples, β₂ is the median and the interval is the pooled t-mixture interval. 'Draft check' rows were computed for this draft by `supp_checks.py` and are not in the committed results files.
